title: How to Repair a Washing Machine that Is Unbalanced
author: Written byTim Bossieon Mar 21, 2010
steps: Place a straight level on top of the washer to see how much off balance the washing machine is.

Most washing machines come with adjustable legs in the front and the back. The front legs can be screwed either in or out to adjust for the correct height. The back legs are spring-loaded. A simple lift of the back end will reset the back legs. Once the back is lowered the legs will level themselves out.

There are times when washing machine drums will loosen because of it being unbalanced for a long time. Even after the legs are reset, the washing machine will still "walk." Check the drum to see if it is too loose. If so, then tighten it.
Large items that get spun to one side will cause loud knocking and shaking of the machine. Keep these items out and hand wash or dry clean them instead.
